```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(nnet)

```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
project_dir <- here()
data_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "data")
figure_output_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "figures", "nn_model_perc")
data_output_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "predicted_data", "nn_model_perc")
```

### Load data

The regression data are used to train and evaluate the network. The level-2 prediction dataset contains the 2025 covariates to predict. Regression population is converted from thousands to persons for consistency with prediction data; the conversion does not change within-province shares.

```{r}
regression_data <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "training_data/regression_dataset.csv")
)
prediction_data <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "training_data/prediction_dataset.csv")
)
provincial_grdp_data <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "_vnm_indicators/vnm_GRDPpc.csv"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
regression_data$population <- regression_data$population * 1000

training_years <- 2020:2024
holdout_year <- 2025
training_data <- regression_data[
  regression_data$year %in% training_years,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
holdout_data <- regression_data[
  regression_data$year == holdout_year,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
if (!identical(sort(unique(training_data$year)), training_years) ||
    nrow(holdout_data) == 0) {
  stop("The regression data must contain 2020–2024 training and 2025 holdout rows.")
}
```

### Preliminaries

For unit \(i\) in parent region \(j\) and year \(t\), let \(y_{ijt}\) be GRDP per capita. Each share is calculated relative to the unit's immediate parent: provincial training observations are shares of the national total for that year, while level-2 prediction observations are shares of their province. The neural network uses standardized mean radiance, population share, pixel-count share, and year indicators:

\[
\hat{y}_{ijt} =
f_{\mathrm{NN}}\left(
\operatorname{scale}(\text{radiance}_{ijt}),
100\frac{\text{population}_{ijt}}{\sum_{k\in j}\text{population}_{kjt}},
100\frac{\text{pixels}_{ijt}}{\sum_{k\in j}\text{pixels}_{kjt}},
\alpha_t
\right).
\]

Population and pixel count are represented as percentages of the immediate parent total. For 2020–2025 provincial regression observations, the parent is the country, so shares are computed across provinces within each year. For the 2025 level-2 predictions, the parent is the province, so the level-2 population shares and pixel-count shares sum to 100 separately in each province. The pixel-count denominator is the sum of the level-2 pixel counts in that province; overlaps are not deduplicated. Radiance continues to use training-set standardization. Year effects \(\alpha_t\) follow the linear/ridge setup: 2025 is held out, and its year-indicator inputs are linearly extrapolated from 2020–2024 when selecting the hidden-unit count and weight decay by 2025 RMSE.

```{r}
make_parent_percentage_features <- function(
  data,
  group_columns
) {
  group <- do.call(
    interaction,
    c(
      unname(data[group_columns]),
      list(drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE)
    )
  )
  population_totals <- ave(data$population, group, FUN = sum)
  pixel_totals <- ave(data$pixel_count, group, FUN = sum)
  if (any(!is.finite(population_totals)) || any(population_totals <= 0)) {
    stop("Each province-year must have a positive, finite level-2 population total.")
  }
  if (any(!is.finite(pixel_totals)) || any(pixel_totals <= 0)) {
    stop("Each province-year must have a positive, finite sum of level-2 pixel counts.")
  }

  data$population_pct <- 100 * data$population / population_totals
  data$pixel_count_pct <- 100 * data$pixel_count / pixel_totals
  data
}

validate_percentage_totals <- function(data, group_columns) {
  group <- do.call(
    interaction,
    c(
      unname(data[group_columns]),
      list(drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE)
    )
  )
  totals <- aggregate(
    cbind(population_pct, pixel_count_pct) ~ group,
    data = data,
    FUN = sum
  )
  if (any(abs(totals$population_pct - 100) > 1e-8) ||
      any(abs(totals$pixel_count_pct - 100) > 1e-8)) {
    stop("Population and pixel-count percentages must each sum to 100 within every province-year.")
  }
  totals
}

training_data <- make_parent_percentage_features(
  training_data,
  "year"
)
holdout_data <- make_parent_percentage_features(
  holdout_data,
  "year"
)
prediction_data <- make_parent_percentage_features(
  prediction_data,
  c("level_1", "year")
)

training_share_check <- validate_percentage_totals(
  training_data,
  "year"
)
holdout_share_check <- validate_percentage_totals(
  holdout_data,
  "year"
)
prediction_share_check <- validate_percentage_totals(
  prediction_data,
  c("level_1", "year")
)

radiance_mean <- mean(training_data$mean_radiance)
radiance_sd <- sd(training_data$mean_radiance)
if (!is.finite(radiance_sd) || radiance_sd <= 0) {
  stop("Training mean radiance must have a positive, finite standard deviation.")
}
prepare_radiance <- function(data) {
  data$mean_radiance_scaled <-
    (data$mean_radiance - radiance_mean) / radiance_sd
  data
}

training_year_weights <-
  rep(1 / length(training_years), length(training_years)) +
  (holdout_year - mean(training_years)) *
    (training_years - mean(training_years)) /
    sum((training_years - mean(training_years))^2)
names(training_year_weights) <- as.character(training_years)

add_year_indicators <- function(data, years, extrapolation_weights = NULL) {
  for (year in years) {
    if (is.null(extrapolation_weights)) {
      data[[paste0("year_", year)]] <- as.numeric(data$year == year)
    } else {
      data[[paste0("year_", year)]] <-
        unname(extrapolation_weights[as.character(year)])
    }
  }
  data
}

training_data <- add_year_indicators(
  prepare_radiance(training_data),
  training_years
)
holdout_data <- add_year_indicators(
  prepare_radiance(holdout_data),
  training_years,
  training_year_weights
)
prediction_data <- prepare_radiance(prediction_data)

predictors <- c(
  paste0("year_", training_years),
  "mean_radiance_scaled",
  "population_pct",
  "pixel_count_pct"
)
design_formula <- reformulate(predictors, intercept = FALSE)
X_train <- model.matrix(design_formula, data = training_data)
X_holdout <- model.matrix(design_formula, data = holdout_data)
y_train <- training_data$grdp_per_capita
y_holdout <- holdout_data$grdp_per_capita
response_mean <- mean(y_train)
response_sd <- sd(y_train)
if (!is.finite(response_sd) || response_sd <= 0) {
  stop("Training outcomes must have a positive, finite standard deviation.")
}
y_train_scaled <- (y_train - response_mean) / response_sd
holdout_total_sum_squares <- sum((y_holdout - mean(y_holdout))^2)
if (!is.finite(holdout_total_sum_squares) || holdout_total_sum_squares <= 0) {
  stop("2025 holdout outcomes must have positive finite variance.")
}

fit_neural_network <- function(x, y, size, decay, seed, maxit = 3000) {
  set.seed(seed)
  fit <- nnet(
    x = x,
    y = matrix(y, ncol = 1),
    size = size,
    decay = decay,
    linout = TRUE,
    maxit = maxit,
    MaxNWts = 5000,
    rang = 0.1,
    trace = FALSE
  )
  if (fit$convergence != 0) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Neural network did not converge (size=%d, decay=%g, seed=%d).",
      size,
      decay,
      seed
    ))
  }
  fit
}

predict_grdp <- function(model, newdata) {
  as.vector(predict(model, newdata = newdata)) * response_sd +
    response_mean
}

write.csv(
  rbind(
    transform(training_share_check, dataset = "training"),
    transform(holdout_share_check, dataset = "holdout"),
    transform(prediction_share_check, dataset = "level2_prediction")
  ),
  file.path(data_output_dir, "nn_model_perc_share_totals.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

### 2025 holdout tuning

Tune hidden-layer size and weight decay on the 2025 holdout. Each candidate is fit only to 2020–2024, using within-province population and pixel-count percentages and training-only radiance scaling.

```{r}
hidden_units_grid <- c(1, 2, 3, 5)
decay_grid <- c(0, 0.01, 0.1, 1)
nn_grid <- expand.grid(
  hidden_units = hidden_units_grid,
  weight_decay = decay_grid
)
nn_grid$holdout_RMSE <- NA_real_
nn_grid$holdout_R_squared <- NA_real_
nn_holdout_predictions <- vector("list", nrow(nn_grid))

for (grid_index in seq_len(nrow(nn_grid))) {
  candidate <- fit_neural_network(
    x = X_train,
    y = y_train_scaled,
    size = nn_grid$hidden_units[grid_index],
    decay = nn_grid$weight_decay[grid_index],
    seed = 1401 + grid_index
  )
  prediction <- predict_grdp(candidate, X_holdout)
  residual <- y_holdout - prediction
  nn_holdout_predictions[[grid_index]] <- prediction
  nn_grid$holdout_RMSE[grid_index] <- sqrt(mean(residual^2))
  nn_grid$holdout_R_squared[grid_index] <-
    1 - sum(residual^2) / holdout_total_sum_squares
}

selected_nn_index <- which.min(nn_grid$holdout_RMSE)
selected_hidden_units <- nn_grid$hidden_units[selected_nn_index]
selected_weight_decay <- nn_grid$weight_decay[selected_nn_index]
best_holdout_predictions <- nn_holdout_predictions[[selected_nn_index]]
holdout_residuals <- y_holdout - best_holdout_predictions
write.csv(
  nn_grid,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "nn_model_perc_hyperparameter_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

ols_fit <- lm.fit(x = X_train, y = y_train_scaled)
ols_coefficients <- ols_fit$coefficients
ols_coefficients[is.na(ols_coefficients)] <- 0
ols_holdout_predictions <- as.vector(X_holdout %*% ols_coefficients) *
  response_sd + response_mean
ols_holdout_residuals <- y_holdout - ols_holdout_predictions
holdout_total_sum_squares <- sum((y_holdout - mean(y_holdout))^2)
holdout_model_stats <- data.frame(
  model = c("Percentage-feature neural network", "OLS reference"),
  R_squared = c(
    1 - sum(holdout_residuals^2) / holdout_total_sum_squares,
    1 - sum(ols_holdout_residuals^2) / holdout_total_sum_squares
  ),
  RMSE = c(
    sqrt(mean(holdout_residuals^2)),
    sqrt(mean(ols_holdout_residuals^2))
  )
)
print(holdout_model_stats, row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf(
  "Selected hidden units: %d; weight decay: %g; holdout RMSE: %.6f\n",
  selected_hidden_units,
  selected_weight_decay,
  nn_grid$holdout_RMSE[selected_nn_index]
))

holdout_predictions <- data.frame(
  province = holdout_data$province,
  year = holdout_year,
  actual = y_holdout,
  nn_fitted = best_holdout_predictions,
  nn_residual = holdout_residuals,
  ols_fitted = ols_holdout_predictions,
  ols_residual = ols_holdout_residuals,
  population_pct = holdout_data$population_pct,
  pixel_count_pct = holdout_data$pixel_count_pct,
  mean_radiance = holdout_data$mean_radiance
)
write.csv(
  holdout_predictions,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "nn_model_perc_2025_holdout_predictions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

holdout_plot <- ggplot(holdout_predictions) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = actual, y = nn_fitted, color = "Neural network"),
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = actual, y = ols_fitted, color = "OLS reference"),
    shape = 1,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "gray35") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Neural network" = "#0072B2",
      "OLS reference" = "#D55E00"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2025 holdout: actual vs fitted (percentage features)",
    x = "Actual GRDP per capita",
    y = "Predicted GRDP per capita",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave(
  file.path(figure_output_dir, "nn_model_perc_2025_holdout_actual_vs_fitted.png"),
  holdout_plot,
  width = 11.25,
  height = 6.875,
  dpi = 160
)
```

### Refit model and training diagnostics

Refit the selected network on all available years. Year indicators include a separate effect for each year, including 2025.

```{r}
all_years <- sort(unique(regression_data$year))
final_training_data <- make_parent_percentage_features(
  regression_data,
  "year"
)
final_training_data <- add_year_indicators(
  prepare_radiance(final_training_data),
  all_years
)
final_predictors <- c(
  paste0("year_", all_years),
  "mean_radiance_scaled",
  "population_pct",
  "pixel_count_pct"
)
final_design_formula <- reformulate(final_predictors, intercept = FALSE)
final_X <- model.matrix(final_design_formula, data = final_training_data)
final_y <- final_training_data$grdp_per_capita
final_response_mean <- mean(final_y)
final_response_sd <- sd(final_y)
if (!is.finite(final_response_sd) || final_response_sd <= 0) {
  stop("All-years outcomes must have a positive, finite standard deviation.")
}
final_y_scaled <- (final_y - final_response_mean) / final_response_sd

set.seed(1401)
final_nn_model <- nnet(
  x = final_X,
  y = matrix(final_y_scaled, ncol = 1),
  size = selected_hidden_units,
  decay = selected_weight_decay,
  linout = TRUE,
  maxit = 3000,
  MaxNWts = 5000,
  rang = 0.1,
  trace = FALSE
)
if (final_nn_model$convergence != 0) {
  stop("Final all-years neural network did not converge.")
}
final_nn_fitted <- as.vector(predict(final_nn_model, newdata = final_X)) *
  final_response_sd + final_response_mean
final_nn_residuals <- final_y - final_nn_fitted
final_ols_fit <- lm.fit(
  x = final_X,
  y = (final_y - final_response_mean) / final_response_sd
)
final_ols_coefficients <- final_ols_fit$coefficients
final_ols_coefficients[is.na(final_ols_coefficients)] <- 0
final_ols_fitted <- as.vector(final_X %*% final_ols_coefficients) *
  final_response_sd + final_response_mean

training_diagnostics <- data.frame(
  province = final_training_data$province,
  year = final_training_data$year,
  year_factor = factor(final_training_data$year),
  actual = final_y,
  nn_fitted = final_nn_fitted,
  nn_residual = final_nn_residuals,
  ols_fitted = final_ols_fitted,
  ols_residual = final_y - final_ols_fitted,
  mean_radiance = final_training_data$mean_radiance,
  population_pct = final_training_data$population_pct,
  pixel_count_pct = final_training_data$pixel_count_pct
)
training_diagnostics <- training_diagnostics %>%
  mutate(
    standardized_residual = nn_residual / sd(nn_residual),
    scale_location = sqrt(abs(standardized_residual))
  )
write.csv(
  training_diagnostics,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "nn_model_perc_training_diagnostics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

training_total_sum_squares <- sum((final_y - mean(final_y))^2)
training_model_stats <- data.frame(
  model = c("Percentage-feature neural network", "OLS reference"),
  R_squared = c(
    1 - sum(training_diagnostics$nn_residual^2) /
      training_total_sum_squares,
    1 - sum(training_diagnostics$ols_residual^2) /
      training_total_sum_squares
  ),
  RMSE = c(
    sqrt(mean(training_diagnostics$nn_residual^2)),
    sqrt(mean(training_diagnostics$ols_residual^2))
  )
)
print(training_model_stats, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
training_actual_fitted <- ggplot(training_diagnostics) +

  ) +

residual_year_plot <- ggplot(
  training_diagnostics,
  aes(x = year_factor, y = nn_residual)
) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#B8D8E8", color = "#0072B2") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = "Residual by year", x = "Year", y = "Residual") +
  theme_minimal()
residual_share_plot <- ggplot(
  training_diagnostics,
  aes(x = population_pct, y = nn_residual)
) +
  geom_point(color = "#D55E00", alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  labs(title = "Residual vs population share", x = "Population share (%)", y = "Residual") +
  theme_minimal()
residual_diagnostics_plot <-
  (residual_fitted_plot | residual_qq_plot) /
  (residual_year_plot | residual_share_plot) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Neural-network percentage-feature diagnostics")
ggsave(
  file.path(figure_output_dir, "nn_model_perc_training_residual_diagnostics.png"),
  residual_diagnostics_plot,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 180
)
```

### 2025 level-2 predictions

Predict each level-2 unit using its province's within-2025 population and pixel-count shares. Then, as in the linear model, add a province-specific adjustment so population-weighted predictions match the reported 2025 provincial GRDP-per-capita target.

```{r}
if (anyNA(prediction_data$year) || any(prediction_data$year != 2025)) {
  stop("The level-2 prediction dataset must contain only 2025 observations.")
}
if (any(!complete.cases(prediction_data[, c(
  "name", "level_1", "population", "mean_radiance", "pixel_count"
)]))) {
  stop("Level-2 prediction data contains missing required values.")
}
if (any(!is.finite(prediction_data$population)) ||
    any(prediction_data$population < 0)) {
  stop("Level-2 populations must be finite and non-negative.")
}
if (anyDuplicated(paste(prediction_data$level_1, prediction_data$name, sep = "\r"))) {
  stop("Level-2 prediction data contains duplicate units within a province.")
}

prediction_data <- make_parent_percentage_features(
  prediction_data,
  c("level_1", "year")
)
prediction_data <- add_year_indicators(
  prepare_radiance(prediction_data),
  all_years
)
prediction_X <- model.matrix(final_design_formula, data = prediction_data)
if (!identical(colnames(prediction_X), colnames(final_X))) {
  stop("Level-2 prediction design does not match the final neural-network model.")
}
raw_predictions <- as.vector(
  predict(final_nn_model, newdata = prediction_X)
) * final_response_sd + final_response_mean
if (any(!is.finite(raw_predictions))) {
  stop("Neural-network level-2 predictions must be finite.")
}

prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025 <- provincial_grdp_data[["2025"]][
  match(prediction_data$level_1, provincial_grdp_data$province)
]
if (anyNA(prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025) ||
    any(!is.finite(prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025))) {
  stop("Missing or invalid 2025 provincial GRDP-per-capita target.")
}

province_names <- sort(unique(prediction_data$level_1))
province_adjustments <- setNames(numeric(length(province_names)), province_names)
for (province in province_names) {
  index <- which(prediction_data$level_1 == province)
  province_population <- sum(prediction_data$population[index])
  if (!is.finite(province_population) || province_population <= 0) {
    stop(sprintf("Province %s has no positive level-2 population.", province))
  }
  target_total <- prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025[index[1]] *
    province_population
  raw_total <- sum(
    prediction_data$population[index] * raw_predictions[index]
  )
  province_adjustments[[province]] <-
    (target_total - raw_total) / province_population
}

prediction_data$raw_grdp_per_capita <- raw_predictions
prediction_data$province_adjustment <-
  unname(province_adjustments[prediction_data$level_1])
prediction_data$predicted_grdp_per_capita <-
  prediction_data$raw_grdp_per_capita +
  prediction_data$province_adjustment

province_check <- do.call(rbind, lapply(province_names, function(province) {
  index <- which(prediction_data$level_1 == province)
  province_population <- sum(prediction_data$population[index])
  target_total <- prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025[index[1]] *
    province_population
  predicted_total <- sum(
    prediction_data$population[index] *
      prediction_data$predicted_grdp_per_capita[index]
  )
  data.frame(
    province = province,
    population = province_population,
    target_grdp_per_capita = prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025[index[1]],
    predicted_grdp_per_capita = predicted_total / province_population,
    target_total_grdp = target_total,
    predicted_total_grdp = predicted_total,
    difference = predicted_total - target_total
  )
}))
if (any(abs(province_check$difference) >
        1e-8 * pmax(abs(province_check$target_total_grdp), 1))) {
  stop("Calibrated level-2 predictions do not match all provincial GDP targets.")
}
prediction_share_check <- validate_percentage_totals(
  prediction_data,
  c("level_1", "year")
)

level2_predictions <- data.frame(
  level_2 = prediction_data$name,
  level_1 = prediction_data$level_1,
  year = prediction_data$year,
  population = prediction_data$population,
  population_pct = prediction_data$population_pct,
  pixel_count = prediction_data$pixel_count,
  pixel_count_pct = prediction_data$pixel_count_pct,
  mean_radiance = prediction_data$mean_radiance,
  raw_grdp_per_capita = prediction_data$raw_grdp_per_capita,
  province_adjustment = prediction_data$province_adjustment,
  predicted_grdp_per_capita = prediction_data$predicted_grdp_per_capita,
  province_grdp_per_capita_target_2025 = prediction_data$grdp_pc_2025
)
prediction_output <- file.path(
  data_output_dir,
  "nn_model_perc_level2_predictions.csv"
)
write.csv(level2_predictions, prediction_output, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(
  province_check,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "nn_model_perc_province_constraint_check.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
write.csv(
  prediction_share_check,
  file.path(data_output_dir, "nn_model_perc_level2_share_totals.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    model = final_nn_model,
    formula = final_design_formula,
    input_features = c(
      "mean_radiance_scaled",
      "population_pct",
      "pixel_count_pct",
      paste0("year_", all_years)
    ),
    radiance_mean = radiance_mean,
    radiance_sd = radiance_sd,
    training_population_denominator = "sum of provincial populations within year",
    training_pixel_count_denominator = "sum of provincial pixel counts within year",
    prediction_population_denominator = "sum of level-2 populations within province-year",
    prediction_pixel_count_denominator = "sum of level-2 pixel counts within province-year, including overlaps",
    response_mean = final_response_mean,
    response_sd = final_response_sd,
    year_effects = all_years,
    hidden_units = selected_hidden_units,
    weight_decay = selected_weight_decay,
    training_seed = 1401,
    holdout_metrics = nn_grid[selected_nn_index, ],
    holdout_model_stats = holdout_model_stats,
    training_model_stats = training_model_stats
  ),
  file.path(model_output_dir, "neural_network_percentage_model.rds")
)

print(province_check, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Wrote level-2 predictions to", prediction_output, "\n")
head(level2_predictions)
```
